# DevelopersIO

> > Technical blog by Classmethod covering AWS cloud services, AI/ML development, game development, and modern data engineering.

DevelopersIO is Classmethod's developer community platform featuring in-depth tutorials, troubleshooting guides, and technical insights. The site covers AWS infrastructure, AI tools like Claude and MCP, game development with Unity and Godot, data platforms like Snowflake, and practical engineering solutions for cloud-native applications.

## Key Topics

- AWS (Lambda, Backup, EC2, S3, ECS, CloudWatch)
- AI & Machine Learning (Claude, MCP, Bedrock, semantic search)
- Game Development (Unity, Godot, performance optimization)
- Data Engineering (Snowflake, Modern Data Stack)
- Infrastructure as Code (CDK, Terraform)
- Performance Optimization (SoA pattern, cache efficiency, batch processing)
- Cloud Architecture (blue/green deployment, monitoring)
- Troubleshooting & Support
- Developer Tools (AWS CLI, React, Vite)
- Prompt Engineering
